programs.title: Instinct
programs.desc: Devastated by the loss of Cole and Kai, the surviving ninja push on into Prime Empire’s third and final game zone – Terra Domina. They ultimately arrive at the upper-most level where Unagami’s voice tells them that one of the ninja will now face the form of his own most dreaded challenger. Lloyd is selected and finds himself facing an avatar of Harumi.

programs.title: Dance With Tom
programs.desc: Tom Teaches a Kuruhman dance. Kuruhman is the Yugambeh word for Kangaroo, who are curious and listen very carefully to the sounds of the bush. Join Tom and learn to be strong and patient, just like the great Kuruhman!

programs.title: Odd Squad
programs.desc: Opal thinks she has uncovered the location of a legendary Odd Artifact: a 44-leaf clover. In the wrong hands, the clover could cause worldwide, catastrophic oddness! Opal must find the 44-leaf clover before it's too late.
